alignment: Complete source/finding/gold sequence verified for both raw models; primary patient/pair sequence also verified. Physical prior/current/finding plus occurrence index retained. Query controls use independently verified canonical row indices.

bootstrap.rng: numpy.default_rng; paired identical draws for both model arms

interpretation: Primary-run diagnostics are not three-run mean results.
All intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Required-change compliance and same-label invariance do not imply correct predictions; strict both-correct is separately reported.
Oracle accuracy uses test labels in sample and is not a deployable learned baseline.
Supported macro-F1 fixes three gold classes; out-of-set outputs remain errors, pooled as other for confusion accounting.

primary_biovilt_complementarity.interpretation: In-sample correctness oracle; no validation-selected or deployable ensemble is evaluated.

provenance_limitation: Raw predictions omit physical image paths; BioViL-T raw outputs also omit patient/pair IDs. Physical identity follows complete archived manifest order and source/finding/gold matching rather than independently saved per-prediction image paths. These limitations cannot be retrospectively removed.
scope: CPU-only canonical primary-run diagnostics; historical artifacts unchanged
